title: fix(mail): JMAP state/changelog not user-scoped — account isolation gap
description:
SECURITY agent found that StateStore and ChangeLogStore have no user_id dimension. This means:
1. state_version table has scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY only — state bumps for any user increment the same counter, causing all users to see spurious state changes
2. jmap_change_log has no user_id column — Email/changes returns CIDs/IDs for all users' inbound mail since a given state, breaking account isolation

Why this matters: once per-user INBOX mail is provisioned (n1z4), Alice can call Email/changes and receive Bob's inbox CIDs in the changed list, then fetch Bob's mail via Email/get.

What needs to be done:
1. Add user_id column to state_version table: ALTER or recreate as (user_id INTEGER, scope TEXT, version INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, scope))
2. Add user_id column to jmap_change_log table: ALTER or recreate with (user_id INTEGER, seq INTEGER, scope TEXT, item_id TEXT, change TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, seq, scope, item_id))
3. Update StateStore methods to accept user_id parameter — get_state(scope), bump_state(scope) must be scoped to user
4. Update ChangeLogStore query_since to filter WHERE user_id = ?
5. Update all call sites in route_method that call StateStore/ChangeLogStore to pass user_id
6. Migration must handle upgrade path (existing rows have no user_id — assign to user_id=1 as migration default)
